summary: BTC ~$77.4k, +0.9% on the day, closing October about 7.7% down (second red month in a row). The Binance $6.3B hack (29 Oct) overhang is easing: Binance says ~90% of funds restored, BTC/ETH/BNB at 100% backing, withdrawals due to resume 1 Nov. Still weak demand and below key levels, so mildly negative, a little less bearish than this morning.
